descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S06 「每个生产凭据：只存在生产 env 里，泄露过就轮换，而且归它的 BAA 覆盖的那个账号所有（Vertex 在 RoundCompanion-Prod）」 Each production credential: stored only in the production env, rotated if exposed, and owned by the account its BAA covers (Vertex in RoundCompanion-Prod)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1b All provider keys are server-side only, verified on the production deployment: each credential exists only in the production server environment it is synced to, and exposed copies are rotated.（UAT OAT-05 Expected ('All keys server-side only')；TFA-94059 AC 4；TFA-92568 AC 3；TFA-92568 Eng 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • T5 Secrets (AI keys, SES, guardrail ID) are stored only in the production environment, verified on production.（TFA-94703 B3；TFA-94703 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94703 development backlog
  • U2 Every AI provider in active use has a signed, coverage-confirmed BAA: confirmed and coverage-verified for that provider's service and for the account that is actually used, not assumed from the provi …（UAT OAT-05；TFA-94059 AC 1；TFA-94059 AC 2；TFA-92568 AC 8；TFA-92568 Product 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • U3c OpenAI BAA coverage is confirmed for GPT-live specifically, for the org and endpoint production uses, before any real patient dictation.（TFA-94423 AC 2；UAT OAT-05 step 3）
  • T2 Production calls Vertex AI in the RoundCompanion-Prod project, the one under Vikram's BAA.（TFA-94059 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Tim, with access to the production Convex deployment env, the production GitHub Environment, the GCP console for the Vertex project, and the dev deployment (names and fingerprints only). Values are compared by key ID or a short fingerprint, never copied into evidence. The BAA documents from S08.

When For each credential class record: where it is stored; its fingerprint on production and on dev; whether it is among the copies known to have left the server (the env values posted in Slack on 2026-09-15, local .env files, docs, repo history) and its rotation date; the account that owns it; …

Then Each class exists only in the production Convex env and in the GitHub Environment secret it is synced from. Production values differ from dev values. Every value that was exposed has been rotated, with a date. The OpenAI key has a named owner and a rotation path. Each credential's owning account is the one under its BAA. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-05 Expected 'All keys server-side only' and 'coverage-verified … not just assumed'; TFA-94703 B3 'stored only in the production environment'; TFA-94059 AC 5 and AC 2; TFA-94423 AC 2. A production credential that is also in dev, in a client, in the repo or in chat, or that was exposed and not rotated, is a Fail (U1b, T5). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 CONFIG · 配置核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S06 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：CONFIG · 配置核对；辅助：DOC · 文档核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
